name: Wakamatsu-Kawada
tagline: Shinjuku in 16 minutes and Otemachi in 17 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000.
summary: The station is in Shinjuku City, served by Toei Oedo Line. Journey times to the main business districts are 17 minutes to Otemachi, 16 minutes to Shinjuku, 18 minutes to Shibuya and 37 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. The station stands 33.3 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 13.4 m. The land around the station has gentle slopes.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 33.3 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 24.5 m to 37.9 m, a difference of 13.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls outside the projected inundation area. Even so, 4 of the nine points within 400 m fall inside the area, and the deepest projection there is less than 0.5 m. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the small side for the 23 wards.
medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 7 clinics and 21 pharmacies. Day-to-day care is available close to the station. The nearest hospital is 東京女子医科大学病院, about 5 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 国立国際医療センター, about 8 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Toei Oedo Line.
congestion: Toei Oedo Line runs at 147% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 中井→東中野, which this station is not on. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥110,000 to ¥120,000 and 1K ¥120,000 to ¥130,000. 1LDK ¥190,000 to ¥200,000 and 2LDK ¥280,000 to ¥290,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥110,000 to ¥120,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. quiet surroundings pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: Ushigome-Yanagicho is ahead on safety, and little else separates the two.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Wakamatsu-Kawada. It is served by the same lines as Wakamatsu-Kawada. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On safety, Ushigome-Yanagicho comes out ahead.

neighbours.lead: For safety, Waseda; for how close the centre is, Wakamatsu-Kawada.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Wakamatsu-Kawada. Waseda has the Tokyo Metro Tozai Line, a different set from Wakamatsu-Kawada. To Shibuya, for instance, Waseda takes 6 minutes longer. On quiet, Wakamatsu-Kawada comes out ahead.

goodFor: People commuting to Otemachi and Marunouchi
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
noiseSources: 神楽坂高円寺線 (a main road) runs right beside the station, so for a flat close to the station, check whether it faces the road
環状4号線 (1 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: There are gentle slopes around the station, and which block you live on changes how much effort getting about takes.
leads.groceries: There are 9 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 2 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself is outside the projected flood area, but blocks nearby are inside it.
leads.stationNote: Only the Toei Oedo Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is among the highest in the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Morning loading on the lines here is about average for the 23 wards' stations.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
